decisions.reason: The encrypted second channel is core to the firm's strategy of binding mobile communication, and with industry growth and slack there is no shortfall to trigger search.
Mobile PDF signing fits directly with the stated direction toward online contract signing and costs little to maintain alongside the established offer.
The multi-layer end-to-end architecture is a framing of the firm's integrated portfolio, so dropping it would release few resources and gain little.
The email-to-app robot is a niche add-on whose results are still uncertain, but organisational slack lets the firm carry it a while longer.
The QR hardware token faces a shift toward app-based authentication that may push results below aspiration, yet it remains useful for regulated customers who need hardware options.
The payment compliance suite serves the demanding regulatory needs that are central to the firm's value proposition, though it is somewhat peripheral to the core identity offer.
